name: Shrimp Po'Boy with Spicy Mayo & Lemon-Dijon Garden Salad

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 medium carrots
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Juice half of the lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayonnaise, chili-garlic sauce, and salt; whisk to combine and set the spicy mayo aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine bread crumbs, flour, and spices. Add shrimp and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add shrimp to the skillet; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp honey
¾ tsp thyme
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 2 large leaves per sandwich; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim carrots and peel into thin noodle-like sticks using a julienne (or regular) peeler. Add to the salad bowl.
Slice half of the tomatoes and set aside for the sandwiches. Small dice the remaining tomatoes and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Layer with lettuce, shrimp, tomato, and spicy mayo; close with top half of the bun. Serve salad on the side and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
